newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 firmer.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 firmer.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 cent firmer Wednesday on follow-through buying from the previous session, dealers said.
But prices are expected to remain in their recent range ahead of the annual U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners Association dinner that will be held in in New York tonight.
Tuesday, benchmark July closed up 0.07 cent at 11.05 cents per lb after trading from 11.07 to 10.96 cents. The outer contracts settled 0.05 higher to 0.01 lower.
Key levels are expected to remain intact, with technical support seen at 10.92 and then at 10.85 cents, and resistance at 11.11 followed by 11.20 cents basis July.

LIFFE white sugar futures were firmer in brisk volume on Wednesday, which carried benchmark August over its upside target. At 0843 EDT/1343 GMT, the contract stood $0.10 firmer at $319.00, having pierced key $320.00 early in the session. The outer contracts were trading $0.40 higher.
